guardrails: Source identifiers are validated; final prose is not fully mechanically fact-checked.
The agent answers only from the five connected sources (BPS, BNPB, BMKG, Bapanas, SiPongi), not open web search.
Deterministic statistical operations are distinct from ordinary model-written arithmetic.
LLM judge scores are referenceless and are not factual-accuracy measurements.
A SiPongi hotspot is a satellite heat detection, not a confirmed fire.
